# CodeTruth

> CodeTruth is a brand-governance and product-claim verification platform. It checks marketing content against facts extracted from a company's own product configuration, specifications and documentation, and cites the exact source file and line for every factual finding.

Principle: style checkers read words, CodeTruth reads the product. No source, no flag: a factual finding is only raised when it is backed by an approved product fact.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Product overview, workflow, features and FAQ
- [Create an account](/sign-up): Start verifying content
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch

## Notes
- The authenticated application under /app is private and not intended for indexing.
